CustomField.description: Most recent of Last Interaction Date (logged Interactions) and LastActivityDate (completed Tasks/past Events, including synced Outlook email).
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Last_Interaction_Date__c), LastActivityDate, IF( ISBLANK(LastActivityDate), Last_Interaction_Date__c, IF( LastActivityDate > Last_Interaction_Date__c, LastActivityDate, Last_Interaction_Date__c ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The most recent contact of any kind - logged Interaction or synced activity.
CustomField.label: Last Touch Date
